source.task: Bound the s1b-to-s2b semantic readiness gate after the inherited virtual-demand slice
source.bounded_context: Adamas compiler bootstrap chain, HIR lazy lowering, and inherited-demand evidence

claim.text: The bounded s1b-to-s2b run has fresh provenance and green stage-1/precondition evidence, but stage 2 timed out in lazy HIR demand lowering before producing cv2_s2; semantic readiness remains open.
claim.scope: Clean snapshot d38e243c0c4c130f662e7d99dae2a47859303a5c, a descendant of target 30b6e5a164405ded337d39905150d2f96b16aeb6, exact s1b producer 66428bcba74d70f780e954ebd9675e37744a4aaa0e01f1f0cbff7bf15c267009, and one bounded s1b-to-s2b gate
claim.decay_trigger: Any source or compiler change, producer/output/cache/toolchain change, manifest schema or process-probe change, classifier-authority change, or a fresh s2b artifact with a semantic runtime gate

evidence.signal: Manifest run_id=20260717T125255Z-12696 binds clean source snapshot, producer, flags, host/cache context, stage lineage, and status=failed at stage 2; snapshot HEAD is d38e243c0c4c130f662e7d99dae2a47859303a5c and source git state is clean.

Host Crystal 1.20.3 built cv2_s1 in 15.24s with run_safe; plain and canonical no-prelude smokes passed. Stage-1 producer SHA-256 is 66428bcba74d70f780e954ebd9675e37744a4aaa0e01f1f0cbff7bf15c267009; host compiler SHA-256 is f7e63c58a8db10d26ffcf4f766ae8fe3e19773245802f8daf42e5b574a187593; LLVM 22.1.8; target aarch64-apple-darwin25.5.0.

Fresh cv2_s1 self-host build timed out after 902.74s with exit 143; run_safe observed max_rss_kb=4155600, complete pgrep tree coverage, and no cv2_s2 output. No stage-2 smoke or s3b-s5b run was accepted.

evidence.unretained_ref: Interactive adversarial wrong-content RED transcript; observed before the exact-stdout fix and not retained as a canonical raw artifact
evidence.signal: The retained first RED timing fixture proved the old one-line stdout contract rejected canonical no-prelude output (marker_count=1, stdout_lines=3). An unretained adversarial wrong-content RED then proved that line count plus marker presence admitted semantically wrong output. The final GREEN harness requires exact canonical stdout plus exactly one semantic marker; missing, duplicate, and wrong-content fixtures fail closed. Timing and integrity specs pass 3/0/0 each through run_safe with complete process-tree telemetry.
Focused HIR has 286 examples, 0 failures, 0 errors, and 2 existing pending; MIR has 39/0/0. Compare-script, process-tree, and resource-metric preconditions pass 6/0/0, 5/0/0, and 4/0/0 respectively.

Against authoritative cv2_s1, no_override d=0/1/8/16 reports body=1, child_body=0, dispatch=0; override d=8 reports body=2, Child0=1, Child1=0, dispatch=1; generic and overload negative controls pass.

Seven same-source rows compile and run with matching statuses: no_override=41 at d=0/1/8/16, override=42, generic=41, overload=0. This precondition was produced by an earlier fresh stage-1 producer SHA-256 4c2881adba29f510dee37548057bea88845944b2271619718ce32a799d0026ca, not by the authoritative 66428bc... gate; it is not an s2b proof.

Forward census and semantic shape assertions pass for all seven rows: no-override keeps one Parent body, zero Child bodies, and zero vdispatch; override retains Child plus vdispatch; generic omits Box value; overload retains both demanded Parent overloads. The fresh aggregate digest hashes concatenated summary JSON contents in sorted relative-path order. Raw function totals, linkage differences, and conservative reachability remain inventory/provisional evidence only. The matrix uses the earlier fresh stage-1 producer noted above.

Two read-only macOS samples of the exact s1b HIR-only probe agree on flush_pending_functions -> lower_missing_call_targets -> process_pending_lower_functions -> lower_method(force_class_method), with a hot inline_yield_function -> lower_while -> inline_block_body branch. resolve_call_tuple appears only in nested low-count branches and is not the hot root.

evidence.ref: ephemeral PTY transcript for exact s1b 60s HIR-only probe (not retained as a canonical raw artifact)
evidence.signal: Existing progress telemetry shows finite but accelerating worklist demand: functions 218->494 (+276) after 259 lowered, 515->1322 (+807) after 531, and 1323->5909 (+4586) after 1742; the final observed queue grew from 1017 to 1426 while lowering. No pending-explosion marker appeared. Classify as broad HIR performance/demand frontier, not proven stationary nontermination.

dod_commands: bash scripts/validate-landmark-graph.sh (not available in this checkout at G0; fallback only)
verification.dod_signal: The packet parses, shell syntax and whitespace checks are clean, and focused timing/integrity specs pass; the canonical graph validator is unavailable, so JSON/schema/path checks are the strongest available fallback. The actual s2b capability remains unverified because stage 2 timed out before producing cv2_s2.

residual_risk: The compiler capability remains blocked before s2b output by broad lazy-HIR pending-lowering demand growth. The progress evidence is transient and not a canonical raw log; runtime/LLVM preconditions came from an earlier fresh stage-1 producer and are explicitly not authoritative s2b evidence. Original HIR/MIR remain unavailable, raw LLVM counts are not readiness, resolve_call_tuple was not the hot-root owner in the sampled path, and no s3b-s5b stage was run. The next legal step is a focused per-owner/context falsifier with fresh provenance, not a longer heavy retry.
